problems.title: Maximum and its position
problems.statement: Read n (n >= 1) and then n integers. Print the maximum value and the 1-based position of its first occurrence, separated by a space.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Printed the 0-based index instead of the 1-based position.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop runs one step past the data and compares the zero in a[n].

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Printed position and value in the wrong order.

problems.title: Print array reversed
problems.statement: Read n and then n integers. Print them in reverse order separated by single spaces, followed by a newline.

bugs.label: CPP_WRONG_LOOP_DIR
bugs.note: Walked the array from the front instead of from the back.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Started the backward loop at index n, one past the last element.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Stopped before index 0, so the first element is never printed.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Used a comma as the separator instead of a space.

problems.title: Range sums with prefix sums
problems.statement: Read n, then n integers, then q and q queries l r (1-based, inclusive). For each query print the sum of elements l..r on its own line.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Subtracted the prefix at l instead of l-1, dropping element l.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Prefix loop stops before n so the last element is never read.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Prefix sums stored in int overflow for large values.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Wrong formula for the range sum.

problems.title: Rotate array left
problems.statement: Read n (n >= 1), k (0 <= k <= 10^9) and n integers. Print the array rotated left by k positions, each number followed by a space, then a newline.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Destination index is shifted by one position.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Print loop goes one element too far and prints an extra 0.

bugs.label: CPP_WRONG_LOOP_DIR
bugs.note: Printed the rotated array from the end.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Forgot to reduce k modulo n, so large k gives negative indexes.

problems.title: Count pairs with given sum
problems.statement: Read n, a target t and n integers. Print the number of index pairs i < j with a[i] + a[j] == t.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Inner loop starts at i, so an element is paired with itself.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Inner loop reads a[n], an extra zero element.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Leaves the inner loop after the first match, missing other partners.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Counted pairs with sum at least t instead of exactly t.

problems.title: Most frequent value
problems.statement: Read n (n >= 1) and then n integers between 0 and 99. Print the most frequent value (the smallest one if several tie) and how many times it appears.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop stops before 99, so 99 can never win.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Counted into the slot next to the right one.

bugs.label: CPP_WRONG_LOOP_DIR
bugs.note: Scanned values from the top, so ties pick the largest value.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Used >= so ties pick the last value instead of the smallest.

problems.title: Merge two sorted arrays
problems.statement: Read n and m, then a sorted array of n integers and a sorted array of m integers. Print the merged sorted array, each number followed by a space.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Merge loop continues once the first array is used up and takes a[n] = 0.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Leftover loop forgets the last element of the first array.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Picked the larger front element, so the merge is not ascending.

problems.title: Longest run of equal values
problems.statement: Read n (n >= 1) and then n integers. Print the length of the longest block of equal consecutive values.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Compared with the next element instead of the previous one.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop reads a[n] (a zero) as part of the data.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Best is only updated when a run ends, so the final run is never counted.

problems.title: Count peaks
problems.statement: Read n and then n integers. Count the positions strictly between the first and last element whose value is strictly greater than both neighbours, and print the count.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop includes the last element, whose right neighbour does not exist.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Loop ends one position too early and misses the last interior element.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Used || so greater than one neighbour counts as a peak.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Allowed equality with the left neighbour, counting plateaus.

problems.title: Second largest distinct value
problems.statement: Read n and then n integers. Print the second largest distinct value, or NONE if all values are equal.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop reads a[n] = 0, which beats negative data.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Started at index 1 and skipped the first element.

bugs.label: CPP_RANGE_CHECK
bugs.note: Used || in the second-largest test.

bugs.label: CPP_ASSIGN_VS_COMPARE
bugs.note: Wrote = instead of == in the NONE test.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Forgot to exclude values equal to the maximum.

problems.title: First occurrence by binary search
problems.statement: Read n, then a sorted array of n integers, then q and q queries. For each query print the 0-based index of the first occurrence of the value, or -1 if it is absent.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop stops when one candidate is left, so it is never checked.

bugs.label: CPP_STALE_EXIT
bugs.note: Stops at the first hit instead of continuing left for the first occurrence.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Upper bound starts at n, one past the last element.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Moved the search in the wrong direction.

problems.title: Both diagonals of a square matrix
problems.statement: Read n and an n x n matrix of integers. Print the sum of the main diagonal plus the anti-diagonal, counting the centre cell only once when n is odd.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Anti-diagonal column index is off by one.

bugs.label: CPP_INT_OVERFLOW
bugs.note: Diagonal sums in int overflow for large entries.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Centre cell is counted twice for odd n.

problems.title: Bubble sort
problems.statement: Read n and then n integers. Sort them in ascending order with bubble sort and print them, each followed by a space.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Inner loop compares a[n-1-i] with the element past the unsorted part.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Not enough passes: outer loop stops one pass early.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Swap condition reversed, sorting in descending order.

problems.title: Letter frequency table
problems.statement: Read one word of lowercase letters. For each letter that occurs, in alphabetical order, print the letter, a space and its count on its own line.

bugs.label: CPP_LOOP_BOUNDARY
bugs.note: Loop stops before index 25, so z is never printed.

bugs.label: CPP_OFF_BY_ONE
bugs.note: Counted into the next letter's slot.

bugs.label: CPP_WRONG_LOOP_DIR
bugs.note: Printed letters from z down to a.

bugs.label: CPP_OTHER_ERROR
bugs.note: Printed the letter number instead of the letter.
